title_zh: 酒店长椅上的蓝色旅行箱
primary_anchor_zh: 圆角轮廓和宽阔青蓝色箱面
story_reason_zh: 旅行箱被暂时送到前台贴行李牌，随后放回长椅

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 大型旅行箱在复古酒店大堂的长椅上，保持静置，皮质吊牌轻微摆动。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 保持静置，皮质吊牌轻微摆动
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 圆角轮廓和宽阔青蓝色箱面占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 酒店服务员缓慢推着旅行箱穿过附近拱门并离开画面；随后呈现空长椅和大堂盆栽。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 酒店服务员缓慢推着旅行箱穿过附近拱门并离开画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 酒店服务员缓慢将旅行箱推回画面并停在原长椅上
shot_design.main_action_zh: 酒店服务员缓慢将旅行箱推回画面并停在原长椅上
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新清楚呈现圆角轮廓和宽阔青蓝色箱面，物件占据足够画面面积。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed medium shot frames a large rounded turquoise suitcase on a bench in a vintage hotel lobby. Its broad leather tag moves slightly. Warm brass lighting makes the suitcase a bold central object.

A fixed medium shot shows a large rounded turquoise suitcase on a bench in a vintage hotel lobby. A hotel attendant slowly rolls the suitcase through a nearby archway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty bench and the tall lobby plant. Palm leaves beside the window sway gently.

A fixed medium shot holds on the empty bench and the tall lobby plant. A hotel attendant slowly rolls the large rounded turquoise suitcase back through the archway and stops it on a bench in a vintage hotel lobby.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 酒店服务员缓慢推着旅行箱穿过附近拱门并离开画面
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 酒店服务员缓慢将旅行箱推回画面并停在原长椅上
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
